chapter: Alfred Williams and the Ruidoso summer
title: Working with Boots and his Buddies in San Antonio
summary: Watts worked four months with Boots in San Antonio until the bandleader's trouble with young Mexican girls, then returned to El Paso.

story.theme_name: Life on the road: touring bands, buses and one-nighters
story.community_name: Life on the road: buses, trains and one-nighters

blocks.x: What about a boot? Didn't some of those guys play with boots and his buddies? Boots and his buddies?

That's he. He about know them. That's when I said they told him. You did? Oh, I went up to San Antonio and worked with him a while. Yeah, boy. Yeah. He was a drummer, wasn't he? Huh? Was he a drummer? Yeah. Yeah. He come to El Paso. Oh, I worked with him in San Antonio about four months. And then it got on it, man, about them young Mexican girls there, man. Oh, I see. So, man, he messed up some girls there. Oh, no. He had to leave there. No wonder he's out of El Paso. And I got out before they, before they, before they rolled him out, or real, I beat it. I came on, fell on back to El Paso. But El Paso's always been my jumping off place. You know, I've just been successful out there. You know, if I didn't work in El Paso, I'd be able to do it. Wait a minute.
